description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Wernog.
When Wernog leaves and enters, it triggers twice, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat.
